        self._mentor = Mentor.alternateConstructor(aNameForMentor, self)

    @classmethod
    def alternateConstructor(cls, aName, aNumber, aMentor):
        self = cls.__new__(cls)
        __class__._alternateInit(self, aName, aNumber, aMentor)
        return self

    def _alternateInit(self, aName, aNumber, aMentor):
        self._name = aName

        self._mentor = aMentor

        return True

    def setNumber(self, aNumber):
        self._number = aNumber
        return True

    def getName(self):
        return self._name

    def getNumber(self):
        return self._number

    def getMentor(self):
        return self._mentor

    def delete(self):
        existingMentor = self._mentor
        self._mentor = None
        if existingMentor is not None:
            existingMentor.delete()

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
                + "name:" + str(self.getName()) + ","
                + "number:" + str(self.getNumber())
